definitions.explanation: A person who has a lot of money.

examples.japanese: {金持|かねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{金持|かねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっても→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧⟦とは→とは：noentry⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you become rich, it doesn't necessarily mean you'll be happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金持|かねも}ち⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→易しい／優しい：00475_yasashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's wealthy, but he's a very kind person.

notes:
{金持|かねも}ち is the most common everyday word for a rich or wealthy person. It can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧ (money) + ⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (having, from 持つ). Literally "one who has money."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金持|かねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become rich
- ⟦お{金持|かねも}ち→お金持ち：01989_okanemochi⟧: rich person (polite or playful)
- ⟦{大金持|おおがねも}ち→大金持ち：23072_ooganemochi⟧: very rich person
- {金持|かねも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a wealthy person's house

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裕福|ゆうふく}→裕福：14041_yuufuku⟧: wealthy, well-off (na-adjective, slightly formal)
- ⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧: the wealthy class (formal, statistical contexts)
- ⟦{資産家|しさんか}→資産家：16291_shisanka⟧: person of wealth, property owner (formal)

OPPOSITE:
- ⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧: poor
